g.text: Arthur, about that Fables & Frontiers game - it'll mean a lot to both Amir and I if you play.
Hey, Arthur - I know you already said no to that game of Fables & Frontiers, but I think it'll be fun.
Hey, do you want to play Fables & Frontiers with Amir and I? I think it'll be fun.
Hey Arthur. Amir is putting together a game of Fables & Frontiers, and it'd mean a lot to both of us if you'd join.
We have very different definitions of "fun." Sorry, pass.
I think it'd be a lot of fun, and a good bonding experience for all of us.
He feels like the odd man out - the non-military one, the nerd, kind of on the outside. It'd mean a lot to him if we all sat down and played one of his games with him.
Yeah... that's fair. All right, I'll play. Count me in.
At least for one night, to see how it goes.
